desc:
🎯 DRAW PERFECT SHAPE. BEAT YOUR OPPONENT. WIN!

Draw a circle, heart, square and more around the dot as perfectly as you can before time runs out! Watch your ink turn green, yellow or red as you draw, then see who gets the higher accuracy score. One steady line can win the round!

🎯 Every drawing is scored by accuracy, up to 100%
❤️ 1v1 matches with hearts: lose a round, lose a heart
⚡ Use power-ups like Redraw, Guide, +15 seconds, or steal 15 seconds from your opponent
💵 Earn Cash, build win streaks, and unlock chairs and cosmetics
🕺 Win the match and do your victory dance on the table!

Can you draw a more perfect circle than your friends?

👍 Like the game and ⭐ favorite it to support future updates!
